title: Junior Research Fellow
summary: IIT (BHU) invites applications for the position of Junior Research Fellow under the Department of Civil Engineering for a project related to groundwater depletion and land subsidence. Candidates with a relevant post-graduate degree and qualified GATE/NET are eligible to apply. The deadline for submitting applications via email and Google Form is 2026-12-16.
eligibility_bullets: Post Graduate Degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Water Resources/Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS/Engineering Geosciences or M.Sc. degree in Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS, Geography/Geology/Applied Geology, Earth Sciences or equivalent.
Must have qualified GATE/NET or any national level examination conducted by central government departments or institutes like DST, IIT, ISRO etc.
Upper age limit is 30 years with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/Women/physically challenged candidates as per government norms.
how_to_apply_steps: Fill the Application Form (Annexure-I) and prepare a single PDF file attaching all requisite degrees and certificates.
Send the soft copy of the form along with supporting documents to aohri.civ@iitbhu.ac.in with the subject mentioning the post applied before the last date.
Fill and submit the Google Form available at https://forms.gle/TiFMGAbZvKN4kN7GA.
